diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_lambda_function.main must wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.vpc_execution_role when VPC networking is enabled: Lambda needs the attached EC2 network-interface permissions during provisioning. Referencing the execution role alone does not wait for this attachment. Add depends_on for the attachment.

:resource.aws_lambda_function.main does not wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.xray, so when tracing is enabled the function can become available before its tracing permissions exist. Add depends_on on the policy to ensure tracing permissions are installed before the function is exposed.

:resource.aws_lambda_function.main should wait for :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.lambda_logging so initial invocations have logging permissions. Currently the logging policy is necessarily created after the function because its log-group reference leads back to the function. First name the log group directly from var.lambda.prefix and var.lambda.name instead of referencing the function, then add the function's depends_on on the logging policy; adding depends_on without that refactor would create a cycle.
